nodes.label: AeroResolve
nodes.rationale: Policy-governed airline disruption resolution agent for AIONOS.AI Assignment 3. Simulated prototype: it does not book real flights, pay refunds, or reserve hotels.

nodes.label: Product Thesis
nodes.rationale: During a disruption, passengers need a trusted resolution layer that translates policy into options, takes authorized action, and knows when a human must take over.

nodes.label: Model Talks, Deterministic Code Decides
nodes.rationale: Not a generic LLM chatbot. LLMs handle ambiguity and wording; deterministic systems handle policy, authority, and irreversible actions. Policy outcomes are never taken from the model.

nodes.label: AERO Resolve
nodes.rationale: Passenger platform at localhost:3000. Has no CRM navigation; supervisors work only in AERO OPS.

nodes.label: AERO OPS
nodes.rationale: Supervisor CRM at localhost:3001, a separate product from the passenger app.

nodes.label: Platform Factory
nodes.rationale: Both UIs are built from packages/ui via createPlatform("customer" | "manager") so the two products stay separated.

nodes.label: Meher Kaur Scenario
nodes.rationale: Meher's ₹2,000 fare difference is from section 6 of the data pack, not from the booking table. No alternative flight number is supplied.

nodes.label: This Turn's Context Panel
nodes.rationale: The product surface: identity, retrieved facts, missing slots, decision JSON with reason and source.

nodes.label: Context Engineering
nodes.rationale: Each turn builds a CustomerAgentContext packet: retrieve this passenger/booking/session; compute entitlements/deny/escalate; forbid other passengers, raw policies.json, and invented flights.

nodes.label: Extract Prompt
nodes.rationale: Narrow prompt with no eligibility fields; demos work with heuristic extract when no OpenAI key is set.

nodes.label: Respond Prompt
nodes.rationale: Explains an already-decided JSON result; does not choose policy outcomes.

nodes.label: Assignment 3 Data Pack
nodes.rationale: Only allowed inputs: customer profiles, bookings, five service rules, allowed vs prohibited actions, three mandatory scenarios. Sample conversations A–C are tone/style only, not policy.

nodes.label: Unknown ≠ Allowed
nodes.rationale: Missing benefits are denied or escalated. External airline research informed UX only and did not become compensation rules. Delay bands are independent thresholds; no next-available inventory is invented.

nodes.label: JSON Data Pack Fallback
nodes.rationale: Without Docker, the same JSON data pack is used instead of Elasticsearch.

nodes.label: Optional OpenAI LLM Phrasing
nodes.rationale: If OPENAI_API_KEY is set, used to extract JSON and polish replies. Demos work with no key via heuristic extract and template reply. Policy outcomes are never taken from the model.

nodes.label: Policy Engine
nodes.rationale: Deterministic rules in backend/policy/engine.py. Delay bands are independent thresholds so lounge still applies at 6 hours. ₹500 is stated only for delays under 3 hours.

nodes.label: Elasticsearch Service
nodes.rationale: Single-node Elasticsearch 8.14.3 with security disabled, exposed on 9200, for the optional passenger knowledge base.

nodes.label: Context-First Loop
nodes.rationale: Customer message is retrieved for this passenger only, intent is extracted, policy is decided in code, then a context packet drives the reply, UI panel, knowledge base, and optional escalation.

nodes.label: RetrieveThisPassengerOnly
nodes.rationale: The LLM never receives the other two passengers.

nodes.label: PolicyEngine
nodes.rationale: Entitlements are computed in policy/engine.py and injected as facts. The LLM never receives policies.json to reinterpret.

nodes.label: ElasticsearchOrJSON
nodes.rationale: If Elasticsearch is down, kb/store.py keeps the same documents in memory from the JSON seed. The agent still must not invent policy.

nodes.label: AIONOS-Style Constraint
nodes.rationale: Domain-tuned reasoning grounded in your data and policies, with human escalation and an auditable record. Split exists so the LLM cannot reinterpret other passengers or raw policy.

nodes.label: Conversation Graph Edges
nodes.rationale: HAS_BOOKING, HAS_DISRUPTION, EVALUATED_UNDER, DENIED_BY, ESCALATED_TO are written as the conversation happens. The manager desk reads that graph; there is no Neo4j.

nodes.label: createPlatform Factory Boundary
nodes.rationale: Two Next.js products share packages/ui through createPlatform(id). Customer chrome cannot construct manager chrome; that is the factory boundary.

nodes.label: 15-Minute Live Demo
nodes.rationale: Do not start with architecture. Start with a passenger. Frame as a resolution desk, not a chatbot wrapper.

nodes.label: Arvind Chip Demo
nodes.rationale: Hotel denied at 4 hours. The system does not invent a hotel because he is missing a meeting.

nodes.label: Manager Desk Demo
nodes.rationale: Human backup does not start from zero: packet, transcript, and graph edges are already present.

nodes.label: Fail Closed on Unknown Benefits
nodes.rationale: If Elasticsearch is down, JSON fallback is used; policies stay in code; unknown benefits fail closed.

nodes.label: Passenger Forced to Become Policy Expert
nodes.norm_label: passenger forced to become policy expert

nodes.label: Journey Compression
nodes.rationale: Status-quo journey is uncertainty → queue → retell → negotiate → wait. AeroResolve compresses to identify → options → authorized action or human packet.

nodes.label: UNDERSTAND GROUND DECIDE ACT ESCALATE AUDIT
nodes.rationale: Chat is the front door. The product is the authority pipeline. Unknown ≠ allowed.
